recipes.title: Clone device from RUN
recipes.summary: Copy any device already in the RUN package — conveyor, spiral, photoeye, motor, scanner, or other table row — with a new name and optional X/Y offset.
steps: Import RUN .tar.gz — dashboard scans all FORTNA and PROJECT tables for devices.
Filter by category (conveyor, spiral, photoeye, motor, …) or browse all devices in the RUN.
Pick a template device already configured on site (e.g. P106, LANE1 SPIRAL, PE106_A).
Enter the new device name and optional X/Y offset for layout placement.
Automation clones the template row and matching rows in related tables (spiral gap bits, full lines, etc.).
Review cloned rows in workspace/active, then repack to exports/.
Deploy to QNX and verify in View I/O / layout.

recipes.title: Add photoeye to conveyor
recipes.summary: Insert a PHOTOCELL row in Conveyor.asc near a belt section and assign I/O word/bit.
steps: Import RUN .tar.gz into Workspace (inbox → active extract).
Pick target conveyor (e.g. P106) from the conveyor list.
Automation clones nearest PHOTOCELL row and sets IO_Name, coordinates, and I/O address.
Review Conveyor.asc in workspace/active — verify X/Y placement on layout.
Update Configio.asc if your site requires explicit digital I/O mapping.
Repack modified RUN to exports/ and deploy to QNX /SortPlus/RUN.
Restart FortnaPlus and test photoeye in View I/O.

recipes.title: Add Print & Apply printer
recipes.summary: Configure Machine, PrinterBoss, PrintApplyLine, and LabelTemplates for a new Zebra printer.
steps: Add Machine table entry: CLOSE_CLIENT, AlphaNum, port 9100, SERV process.
Add /etc/hosts entry for printer IP.
Add PrinterBoss row linked to PrintApplyLine.
Bump NumPrinters on PrintApplyLine.
Define PrinterUpdPnts (Send Label, Tamp, Verify).
Add LabelTemplates row for label type.
Enable PA batches (Ctrl, Serv, Sort, GUI).
Disable Zebra TIMEOUT CHECKING in printer web UI.
